data.description: Benchmarks revealed bigram_connections takes ~103ms of ~160ms total compute time (65%). Investigate O(n²) patterns or optimization opportunities. Use scripts/profile_full_analysis.py or cProfile.

properties.retrospective: Profiled compute_bigram_connections: takes 80% of compute_all time (6.6s of 8.2s on 100-doc corpus). Key finding: 62.7% of pair processing is wasted on maxed-out bigrams. Three optimizations identified: (1) Early bailout for maxed bigrams - ~2.2s savings, (2) Cheaper pair canonicalization - ~300ms savings, (3) Edge pooling - ~200ms savings. Knowledge transfer: samples/memories/2025-12-29-session-knowledge-transfer-bigram-profiling.md

data.title: Profile bigram_connections bottleneck (~65% of compute_all)
